subject: Igbo
examFormat: Two papers forming a composite paper taken at one sitting; rubrics are in Igbo and answers are in Igbo using the standard orthography and metalanguage. Paper 1 has 60 multiple-choice items (Language 30, Literature 22, Culture 8) answered in 1 hour for 60 marks. Paper 2 is a composition test in Sections A (Language), B (Literature) and C (Culture): candidates answer six out of thirteen questions in 2 hours for 100 marks.
excluded: Recommended and listed Igbo texts by year (set books change; described generically). Igbo letters in the lists were garbled by the extraction and are not used.

topics.name: Composition and Letter Writing (Igbo)
topics.content: Candidates are advised not to spend more than 45 minutes on this section. There will be five topics from the listed essay types (narrative, descriptive, argumentative, expository, dialogue, debate, letter writing) and candidates write on one in about 300 words.

topics.name: Sound System (Igbo)
objectives: Describe the production of Igbo phonemes: vowels, consonants and the syllabic nasal
Explain sound processes: vowel harmony, vowel assimilation, vowel elision and consonant elision
topics.content: Two questions are set and candidates answer one.

topics.name: Grammar (Igbo)
objectives: Distinguish Igbo dialects from Standard Igbo
Identify word classes: the noun, verb, pronoun, conjunction, preposition, etc.
Explain grammatical categories: tense, number and person
Describe the types and functions of phrases and clauses
Describe the constituents and types of sentences, including sentences containing direct and indirect speech
topics.content: Two questions are set and candidates answer one.

topics.name: Oral Literature (Igbo)
objectives: Define oral literature and state its characteristics
Describe the classification and functions of oral literature
topics.content: Three questions are set and candidates answer only one. All questions are based on the prescribed texts.

topics.name: Written Literature (Igbo)
objectives: Show knowledge of the prescribed texts in written prose, poetry and drama
topics.content: Three questions are set and candidates attempt only one. All questions are based on the prescribed texts.

topics.name: Customs - Omenala (Igbo)
topics.content: Section C: two questions are set on culture and candidates attempt one.

subtopics.name: Njirimara ndị Igbo and Ekele
objectives: Describe the identity of the Igbo (language, dress, customs, etc.) and Igbo greetings at different times

subtopics.name: Mmemme
objectives: Describe mmemme such as ịtụ nzụ, ịkwọ aka ụtụtụ and ịgọ ọfọ

subtopics.name: Ọmụmụ nwa
objectives: Describe childbirth customs such as ile ọmụgwọ, ibi ugwu, ikupụta nwa, ịgụ aha, ịzụ ahịa nwa and ịhụ eze

subtopics.name: Nkwenye
objectives: Describe beliefs such as ịlọ ụwa, ọgbanje, nrọ, ihi/isi anụ and ịha/ịchụ mmiri

subtopics.name: Emume
objectives: Describe festivals and ceremonies such as ọfala, ịbọ ụzọ, ịwa ji/iri ji, igbu ewuukwu, iru mgbede, ịwa akwa, akwamozu, ịgba mkpe, ịgụ afọ, mbarị and ụdara

subtopics.name: Egwuregwu
objectives: Describe games such as egwu ụmụaka, ịgba/ịchụ oro, ịtụ okwe, ịzụ nchọrọkọtọ, ịkpọ okwe, mgba, ịkpọ ọga, okoso and egwu ọnwa

subtopics.name: Nsọala/Arụ
objectives: Describe taboos and abominations: ihensọ, ebensọ, anụnsọ, osisinsọ and ime ibeeṅe

topics.name: Institutions - Ewumewu (Igbo)
topics.content: Section C: two questions are set on culture and candidates attempt one.

subtopics.name: Ewumewu ọchịchị
objectives: Describe governance institutions: ezinaụlọ, ndị eze ọdịnala, nze na ọzọ, ụmụọkpụ/ụmụada, otu ọgbọ, otu nzuzo, otu inyomdi, ụmụnna, ogbe and obodo

subtopics.name: Ewumewu mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya
objectives: Describe social relationships: alụmalụ, ezinaụlọ, ịgọ ọgọ, nwanwa/nwadiala, ịgba ndụ and ịgba orikọ

subtopics.name: Echichi
objectives: Describe titles such as Lọọlọ, Iyọm, Ọmụ, Ezeji, Jioke and Atama

subtopics.name: Abamaba
objectives: Describe societies such as Mmọnwụ, Ọkọnkọ, Ekpe, Ọmabe, Odo and Dibịa

subtopics.name: Ewumewu akụnaụba
objectives: Describe the economic institutions: ike ekpe, iri ekpe, and land and what is on it

subtopics.name: Akaọrụ
objectives: Describe occupations such as ịkpụ ụzụ, ịgba nta, ịkụ azụ, ọrụugbo, ịkwa nka and ịkpụ ite

subtopics.name: Ewumewu ofufe
objectives: Describe worship institutions such as ịgba afa and ịchụ aja

subtopics.name: Ngwa ofufe
objectives: Identify objects of worship such as ọfọ, ikenga, okpesi, ogu and ọtọnsi

subtopics.name: Ihe ofufe
objectives: Identify what is worshipped: Ndịichie, Arụsị, Ikenga, Ala, Mmụọ mmiri and arụsị/agbara such as Ogwugwu, Ahịajiọkụ, Agwụ, Amadịọha, Kamalụ, Agbala, Ibini Ụkpabị, Ojukwu, Igwekaala and Idemmili
